title: data.pdf — section 66
text:
(12) In all criminal and civil proceedings a code in operation at any time by virtue of an
order under this section shall be admissible in evidence.

(13) If it appears to a court or tribunal conducting criminal or civil proceedings that—
(a) any provision of a code in operation at any time by virtue of an order under
this section, or
(b) any failure mentioned in subsection (11),
is relevant to any question arising in the proceedings, the provision or failure shall be
taken into account in deciding the question.]
